Second instance, pre-existing and untouched by the diff, same block: line 95, 'Optional. The thinking Module 4 asks you to do before you step away from a session' — subject 'Module 4', verb 'asks'. Contrast with the kept M3 sibling (line 87: 'The security frame Module 3 works in' — subject is the frame, not Module 3 as actor; line 91's Willison entry ends on 'where the blast radius ends', the essay's own content, not on what Module 3 does). Verified both lines are present and unchanged in the current file (raw lines 95 and 97) and that no maintainer accept-note in this file's block addresses either — the adjacent new note at line 113 covers only which essay is assigned to which pre-read slot. Harm: mild — this is an optional pre-read blurb, the underlying factual claim about M4 checks out against run-the-first-experiment.md's own body ('running without you watching', line 27 there), so nothing misleading ships; the cost is NVA/cartography and a staleness dependency (a promise M4 must go on cashing) rather than a reader-facing defect. Filed non-blocking.
